_read_me: Assumption-based projections, not forecasts. Each scenario measures reach and conversion from your own recent data, then applies the stated assumptions. Edit the numbers here; the dashboard sliders change them temporarily.

conservative.assumptions: Reach falls back to the typical posting-day level of the last 28 days (the recent carousel lift fades), no reach growth, 2% of followers leave each month.

base.assumptions: Reach stays at the 14-day typical level, conversion stays at the 14-day pooled rate, 1% monthly churn. No growth in reach is assumed.

optimistic.assumptions: Reach holds at the last-7-day typical level and then grows 10% a month (an assumption, not measured), 0.5% monthly churn.

posting_explorer._elasticity_note: Reach multiplier = (new posts per week / current posts per week) ^ elasticity. 0.5 means doubling posts gives about 1.4x reach, not 2x. This is an assumption until your own experiments measure it.
